items.text: The model's parameters are updated based on the newly generated word

In the autoregressive generation process described in the chapter, after ChatGPT generates the word "today" in response to "How is the weather in Shanghai today?", what changes for the next prediction step? (延展题)
The word "today" is added to the context for the next prediction
The vocabulary is reduced to exclude already-used words
The probability distribution is reset to uniform for the next step
